기한이 지나도록 입금하지 않은 주문은 취소하고 재고를 되돌립니다. 기한은: Orders not paid by the deadline are cancelled and their stock is released. The deadline is shown in the order confirmation email and on the order page. 0 turns this off.
카드 등으로 결제를 시작하고 끝내지 않은 주문을 이 시간이 지나면 취소해: Orders where a card (or other online) payment was started but never finished are cancelled after this long, releasing their stock — so a closed payment window does not make the item look sold out to everyone else. 0 turns this off.

adult.gateBody: Under Korea's Juvenile Protection Act, only people aged 19 or over may view and buy this product. Please verify your identity to confirm your age.

허용된 전이만 가능합니다 (예: 배송중 → 배송완료). 결제된 주문을 취: Only allowed transitions work (for example Shipped → Delivered). Changing a paid order to Cancelled or Refunded refunds the payment first (if the refund fails, the status is not changed).
